restaurant.subtitle: Ibi idana ounjẹ igba & ile-iṣẹ to dara

burrata.name: Burrata & awọn tomati heirloom
burrata.short: Burrata ọra, awọn tomati pọn, ekan ti a yan.
burrata.description: Bọọlu asọ ti burrata tuntun, awọn tomati heirloom didùn ati basil, ti pari pẹlu epo olifi. Gbe e pẹlu iyẹfun didan ti o gbona.
burrata.ingredients: Burrata (wara), awọn tomati, basil, epo olifi, ekan (alikama), iyo okun.

dumplings.name: Ata-agaran dumplings
dumplings.short: Golden Ewebe dumplings, Ata epo, scallions.
dumplings.description: Awọn dumplings Ewebe pan-seared mẹfa pẹlu awọn isalẹ agaran ati aarin rirọ. Ti pari pẹlu epo ata ati scallions, pẹlu soy dipping obe lori ẹgbẹ.
dumplings.ingredients: Awọn ohun elo alikama, eso kabeeji, olu, karọọti, scallions, soy sauce (soy, alikama), sesame, epo ata.

pasta.name: tomati & Basil rigatoni
pasta.short: Awọn tomati ti o lọra, basil titun, parmesan.
pasta.description: Ridged pasita toss ni a ọlọrọ, o lọra-sun tomati obe, pẹlu alabapade Basil ati ajewebe parmesan. Itunu, rọrun, ati ṣe fun ounjẹ ọsan pipẹ.
pasta.ingredients: Rigatoni (alikama), awọn tomati, basil, parmesan ajewebe (wara), epo olifi, ata ilẹ.

salad.name: sisun ọgba ekan
salad.short: Awọn ẹfọ sisun, chickpeas, citrus & ewebe.
salad.description: Awọn beets sisun ati ọdunkun didùn lori awọn ọya agaran, pẹlu chickpeas, osan didan ati ewebe tuntun. Wíwọ lẹmọọn kan mu gbogbo rẹ papọ.
salad.ingredients: Beets, ọdunkun didùn, chickpeas, citrus, ọya, parsley, Mint, Sesame, lẹmọọn, epo olifi.

chicken.name: Lemon & ewebe adie
chicken.short: Golden adie, omo poteto, alawọ awọn ewa.
chicken.description: Ewebe-sun adie pẹlu agaran ara, omo poteto ati alawọ awọn ewa. Yoo wa pẹlu kan ina lẹmọọn ati olifi-epo jus.
chicken.ingredients: Adie, poteto, awọn ewa alawọ ewe, lẹmọọn, epo olifi, rosemary, thyme, ata ilẹ.

cake.name: Chocolate ganache akara oyinbo
cake.short: Dark chocolate, fanila ipara, alabapade rasipibẹri.
cake.description: Bibẹ pẹlẹbẹ ọlọrọ ti akara oyinbo Layer chocolate pẹlu ganache chocolate dudu didan kan. Ipara fanila diẹ ati rasipibẹri tuntun ni ẹgbẹ.
cake.ingredients: Chocolate, iyẹfun alikama, ẹyin, bota (wara), ipara (wara), suga, fanila, rasipibẹri.

lemonade.name: Sitiroberi Basil lemonade
lemonade.short: Iru eso didun kan titun, lẹmọọn, basil & omi didan.
lemonade.description: Imọlẹ kan, lemonade didan sere-sere pẹlu awọn strawberries tuntun, fun pọ ti lẹmọọn ati basil aladun. Yoo wa lori yinyin.
lemonade.ingredients: Sitiroberi, lẹmọọn, Basil, suga ireke, omi didan, yinyin.

tea.name: Jasmine tii tii
tea.short: Tii Jasmine ododo, lẹmọọn, yinyin pupọ.
tea.description: Tii jasmine tuntun ti a tun pọn, tutu ati sise lori yinyin pẹlu lẹmọọn. Ti ko dun, pẹlu ipari ododo ododo kan.
tea.ingredients: Jasmine tii, lẹmọọn, omi filtered, yinyin. O ni caffeine ninu.
